csharpUnityUtilities.template.description: Template for new MonoBehaviour scripts. Use {{NAMESPACE}} and {{CLASSNAME}} as placeholders.

scripts.commit-generated: git add CHANGELOG.md README.md && git commit -m "docs: auto-update" || echo 'No changes to commit'
scripts.prebuild: npm run changelog && npm run update-readme && npm run commit-generated && npm version patch
scripts.add-release: git push origin --follow-tags && npx auto-changelog --unreleased --stdout --ignore-commit-pattern '^docs: auto-update$' > temp_release_notes.txt && gh release create v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") build/*.vsix --title v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") --notes-file temp_release_notes.txt && del temp_release_notes.txt
scripts.build: npm run clean-build && npm run compile && npm run prebuild && vsce package --out build && npm run add-release
